name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
description: Reads a Palo Alto Networks firewall (PAN-OS 9.0 or newer) with a read-only API key: the firewall as the gateway with its interfaces, the devices behind it (DHCP leases and ARP), and its health: high availability, IPsec tunnels, firmware and licence expiry. Netlens shows them on a Firewall card and logs events for failover, tunnels going down and licences about to expire. Read-only: only operational show commands. Not yet tested on a real firewall.
author: Netlens
supports: PAN-OS 9.0 or newer (tested against a simulator only)

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.

First release. Written from the vendor's public API documentation and tested against a simulator only: please try it on a real firewall and send the Run diagnostic report if something is missing (needs Netlens 0.4.152 or newer for the Firewall card).
